experience.company_cn: 毕马威企业咨询（中国）有限公司
experience.title: Assistant Technical Consultant (Intern)
bullets: Contributed to system architecture design for a China futures company (order management, settlement, warehouse systems); investigated exchange interfaces and trading rules, mapping data flows across interfaces.
Conducted market research on e-commerce enterprises, rural internet-finance systems and house-rental groups for user segmentation.
Assisted IPO of securities/futures companies; wrote and translated development-plan and management-rule materials.

experience.company_cn: 广发基金管理有限公司
experience.title: Data Analyst Intern
bullets: Studied investor reactions to fund drawdown to identify drawdown tolerance thresholds by client type, providing frontline colleagues a soothing time-window and targeted reassurance.
Explored how investment tenure, risk tolerance, market volatility and peer returns relate to client redemption timing; separately analyzed absolute vs relative returns.
Used Python for image plotting, function fitting and cluster analysis.

research_projects.name: The 2nd IKCEST 'Belt and Road' International Big Data Competition
highlights: Built predictive model for pandemic transmission using new infections, inter-city migration index and population flow.
Forecasted daily infections with linear regression, RNN and LSTM; enlarged training set via linear interpolation; final RMSLE < 1.3 with PyTorch.

research_projects.name: 29th National University Mathematical Modeling Competition
highlights: Built credit-risk evaluation, corporate-reputation and bank credit-strategy models for small/micro enterprises from financial indicators.
Used Python preprocessing and hierarchical analysis to score enterprise credit risk and recommend loan strategies.

research_projects.name: 30th National University Mathematical Modeling Competition
highlights: Modeled catalyst-temperature combinations for C4 olefin yield from ethanol coupling; used dummy variables + multiple linear regression.
Solved nonlinear 0-1 programming with Monte Carlo and greedy algorithm in Python to maximize C4 olefin yield.

research_projects.name: Growth Stock Investment Strategy and Risk Management Research
highlights: Constructed growth-stock selection indicators/models, built growth fund and FOF (fund of funds) systems, backtested position-control strategies and benchmarked against IT ETF.

research_projects.name: Digital Economy Interconnection of the Pearl River Delta Urban Agglomeration
highlights: Built enterprise-relationship network from HQ-branch data of listed digital-economy firms using chain-network models and social network analysis.
Used Wind Financial Terminal + Python preprocessing + ArcGIS to map spatial distribution and analyze network evolution over time.
